description: PTM CMBO - Tavola 3 - Carta di area vasta del rischio idraulico, rischio da frana e dell'assetto dei versanti is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartografia.cittametropolitana.bo.it. The PTM identifies the morphological or geological characteristics of the soils and the natural risk situations in the map of the vast area of hydraulic risk, landslide risk and slope layout. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PTM CMBO - Table 3 - Large area map of hydraulic risk, slope and landslide risk" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP, WMS. The listing shows 2021-03-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode.it). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
